result.title: From Foundation VLM to Versatile Driving VLM: A Triplet Incremental Training Approach
result.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
result.summary: Adapting general Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to Autonomous Driving (AD) is thought to require heavy 3D spatial priors or intrusive architectural overhauls to compensate for a lack of spatial grounding. In this work, we present a counterintuitive pilot study: off-the-shelf general VLMs already exhibit remarkable adaptability across diverse driving tasks, while precise metric depth remains the primary missing link, a bottleneck readily addressable via onboard sensors and depth foundation models. To this end, we introduce the Triplet Incremental Training Framework, a non-intrusive paradigm that seamlessly instills 3D geometric awareness into a general VLM backbone while fully preserving its open-world capabilities. Driven by automatically constructed (image, depth, QA pair) triplets, our framework operates via a unified tri-stream training pipeline: an unfrozen primary VLM stream to adapt to driving tasks, an auxiliary depth stream that guides the visual backbone to implicitly imagine 3D scene geometry via explicit geometric constraints, and a frozen twin VLM stream employing logit-level KL distillation to prevent semantic drift. Crucially, the auxiliary depth branch is discarded during deployment, ensuring the enhanced geometric awareness comes with zero inference overhead. We evaluate our framework across four major benchmarks targeting four diverse capabilities spanning 3D spatial perception, driving-oriented language reasoning, end-to-end planning, and general multimodal understanding. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art driving VLMs, rivals domain-specific expert models in 3D perception, and successfully retains its original general reasoning capabilities. This demonstrates that Triplet Incremental Training offers a unified, deployment-ready paradigm for transforming general foundation models into robust driving intelligences.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何把通用 VLM 迁移到自动驾驶：用自动构造的（图像、深度、QA）三元组做三流增量训练——主 VLM 流适配驾驶任务、深度辅助流以显式几何约束塑造视觉主干、冻结孪生流用 logit 级 KL 蒸馏抑制语义漂移，部署时丢弃深度分支。
AI.relevance_reason: 「训练期引入辅助视觉流、部署期移除」的设置可供核查视觉旁路信息是否真被写入内部状态、以及旁路撤除后是否出现信息坍缩或漂移；但该工作面向驾驶任务、无显式 latent 推理，与主线的联系较间接。
